column1: # models/server-seats.tsv - what the server's llama-server serves, read by server/scripts/llamacpp-check.sh
# (against server/llamacpp/models.ini and, with --weights-container, the GGUF files) and by
# tests/check_config_drift.py. llama.cpp is the only engine since Ollama was removed on 2026-11-21.
# For each seat this file pins:
#   num_ctx   the context the seat serves: its models.ini `c` and opencode/global/opencode.jsonc's
#             llamacpp-server limit.context must equal it (tests/check_config_drift.py, and
#             tests/test-profiles.ps1 against the value the server reports).
#   num_gpu   0 for a CPU seat (no GPU layers); "-" otherwise.
#   from      the base a derived seat was built from (informational; "-" otherwise).
#   weights   sha256 of the seat's GGUF file. A different file is a different model, so its results are a new
#             era. Four seats (qwen3.6, qwen3:8b, the 3b, gpt-oss) loaded Ollama's blobs until 2026-11-21; their
#             GGUFs in ~/models are byte copies, so these hashes are unchanged.
#   source    import-server: a GGUF in the server's ~/models (the /models mount). "import" is the older name
#             for the same thing.
# Columns are tab-separated.
